item.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
item.description: A flaw in Microsoft's hybrid-identity health agent is being actively exploited to pull tenant data, putting on-prem/cloud identity sync in the firing line.

item.title: Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts
item.description: A guest-to-host memory access bug in KVM on AMD breaks the core isolation promise of shared cloud hosts.

item.title: China's 'Armory Castle' Lays Siege to VMware vCenter Zero-Day
item.description: A China-linked group is exploiting an unpatched vCenter bug for admin access; vCenter compromise means control of every VM it manages.

item.title: Amid a year of layoffs, Ubisoft yank the cover off Motherbrain, their new studio "focused on AI for gameplay innovation"
item.description: Ubisoft spins its AI-gameplay R&D team into a standalone subsidiary, signalling where a major publisher is putting money amid cuts.

item.title: "Everyone agrees it's more fun this way": Toby Fox won't tell his team how Deltarune ends until they've built enough of it
item.description: A rare look at an indie lead deliberately withholding the ending from his own team as a production technique; chapter 6 is structurally complete.

item.title: Army delays detonating "catastrophically hazardous" lead azide amid fear, anger
item.description: How to safely dispose of a degraded primary-explosive stockpile is a real chemistry and public-health problem, now stalled by local opposition.

item.title: Show HN: Zero C# – C# without a runtime or GC
item.description: A C# toolchain that compiles without the .NET runtime or garbage collector, aiming C# at bare-metal and tiny-binary targets.
